How to use Voice Sales Register

Short answers for everyday work at the stall. The same words work in every supported language; the examples are in Hinglish.

Getting started Setting prices Making a bill Saying quantities Several customers at once When the app mishears Noisy places Customer mode Money received and pending Scanning a menu Reports Backup

Getting started

Open the app in Chrome on your Android phone and choose your language. Choose Owner, type your shop name if you want it on shared bills, and tap Start billing. To put the app on your home screen, open Chrome's menu and choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.

The first time you tap the microphone, Chrome asks for permission. Choose Allow.

Setting prices

Go to Items, tap the microphone and say the item and its price: “chai 10”, “samosa 15”, “tamatar 40 rupaye kilo”. You can say several at once. You can also type them, add an item by hand with Add item, or photograph your menu (see Scanning a menu). To change a price, say it again or tap the item.

Making a bill

On the Bill screen, tap the microphone and say what the customer had: “do chai teen samosa”. Add more at any time: “aur ek vada pav”. Say “kitna hua” to hear the total. Each line has minus and plus buttons, and Undo takes back the last change. When you are done, tap Save, or say a save phrase on its own, such as “bill bana do”. Asking for the total never saves a bill.

If you cannot speak, tap Tap items to choose from a grid, or tap Type and write the same words.

Saying quantities

  • Numbers as words or digits: “teen”, “3”, “pachaas”.
  • Halves and quarters: “aadha kilo”, “dedh” (one and a half), “dhai” (two and a half), “sava do” (two and a quarter), “paune do” (one and three quarters), “paav kilo”.
  • Weights and packs: kilo, gram, litre, dozen, plate, cup, packet.
  • An amount instead of a weight: “10 rupaye ka dhaniya”.
  • Leaving something out: “samosa nahi”, “bina cheeni”.

Several customers at once

Tap Hold to park the current bill and start a new one. Held bills show at the top with their totals; tap one to continue it. If a bill is left alone for about 12 seconds, the app stops listening and asks whether to continue, save and start a new bill, or start over. You can change the time in Settings.

When the app mishears

Tap Undo, or say “galat”. If a word is not on your list, the bill shows it as “Not on your list”. Tap it once and choose the right item: the app remembers that word for next time.

Noisy places

Hold the phone close to your mouth, or use a wired earphone with a microphone. In Settings, choose “Hold while speaking” so the app listens only while you press the button. Voice needs internet on most phones; tapping and typing always work.

Customer mode

When the stall is busy, tap Customer on the Bill screen and hand the phone to the customer. The first time, you choose a 4-digit PIN. Customers pick their language and order by voice or by tapping pictures; they see prices and the total but cannot save, see your sales or change prices. When they tap Order done, the order waits on your Bill screen with an order number. Tap the order, check it and save it. Only your PIN leaves customer mode.

If you forget the PIN, it cannot be shown again. Clear the app's data in Chrome (Site settings) and restore your last backup file; bills saved after that backup are lost. Android's own app pinning can stop customers from leaving the app.

Money received and pending

Before you save, the yellow total strip shows Money received, ticked. If the customer will pay later, tap it so it shows Not paid yet. Such bills appear under Pending in Reports. When the money comes, open the bill there and tap Mark as received.

Scanning a menu

On the Items screen, tap Scan menu and take a photo of your printed menu or price list: straight on, sharp, in good light. The phone reads it and lists the names and prices it found. Tick, correct and then tap Add to my items. The first scan needs internet to download the reader, about 5 to 7 MB; after that it works offline. Handwriting and fancy fonts read poorly, so always check the list.

Reports

Reports shows your sales for today, yesterday, this week, last week, this month, last month or any dates: the total, the number of bills, sales by item and by hour or day, and every bill. Open a bill to share it again or cancel it. Export to Excel saves the bills as a CSV file.

Backup

Your records live only on your phone. In Settings, tap Save backup file and keep the file on WhatsApp or Google Drive. The app reminds you if you have not saved one for a week. To move to a new phone, open the app there, tap Restore from backup file and choose the file. The file is not password protected, so share it only with people you trust.
